If I ever need dental work in the future I will definitely return to this clinic.

I wrote a review after getting my braces removed...adding an update today.
My retainer broke in less than 2 months...terrible!!! 😡
I just had my braces removed and am currently wearing a retainer.
It's awful. Before getting braces, I clearly told the doctor that I didn't want any tooth extraction, I didn't want to change my facial shape, I didn't want my jaw to change or become narrower. I liked my square face and didn't want it to become narrower. I just wanted my teeth to be aligned... The doctor promised, "Yes, yes, yes, yes, we can do it."

Over 3 years later, after getting the braces off, my lower teeth are still crooked, my upper teeth are still uneven, and my jaw has narrowed, making a very noticeable gap between my lips and teeth when I smile. It makes my face, especially when I smile, look like a buck-toothed parrot. Now I hate looking at photos of myself, I hate looking in the mirror, I hate smiling...

I'm looking for another clinic to get braces done so my teeth don't look like a parrot's. I'd rather pay more than live with a face I can't accept.
